maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells CPAP devices plus recurring masks and accessories resupply; device and mask sales, not repair or servicing, dominate revenue.

publicly_funded.reason: Sells CPAP devices and masks via providers, paid by mixed commercial insurers, Medicare and consumers; no clear government majority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own CPAP, mask and ventilator products and software; acquisitions such as software businesses are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Regulated cloud-connected CPAP and ventilator therapy devices with prescriptions, patient mask fit, and AirView/myAir integration make switching disruptive.

notes: Payer mix (government vs. commercial) and the masks/resupply share of revenue are not stated on the website; they come from general knowledge.
